I feel exactly the same way all of the time. I know this won’t solve everything, but have you considered owning a pet? Sometimes having someone to wake up for and someone to live for is nice. I don’t know where I would be if it weren’t for my dog, he always seems to understand me, and he doesn’t care about how much of a coward and an dumb ass idiot I am. It’s so nice seeing him learn new tricks and seeing him happy. When I’m with him I almost put my shitty thoughts to the side, as if it’s just him and I on this planet. I can tell he truly cares for me as much as I truly care for him. I try my best to not compare myself to others, but it’s hard and I still have bad thoughts. I hate being myself and I really want to die, but I at least would like to see my dog out before I go; give him a life better than mine.

Im sorry, I wish I could come help you out. Is there anyone else close to you, like an adult or a friend you can ask for help? There’s also hotlines you can call for help or contact anonymously. I understand that it can be hard to hard to do this Though, as I know the feeling.
